title: Artifact violates a declared schema
description: documents/document.json uses status=current, which is not allowed by the declared schema.

analysis.observation: The status value current is outside the schema enum active or archived.

impact.statement: The artifact cannot conform to its declared machine-readable contract.

confidence.rationale: The enum violation is directly reproducible against the declared JSON Schema.

treatment.rationale: The contract violation is confirmed and should be corrected through normal remediation.

recommendation.summary: Use an allowed status value or revise the schema through an approved contract change.

review.notes: Approved by the human Tech Lead during Batch 01 review.
